claim: For Record 0, schedule a=1, fixed source orbit 1, no compact joint incidence/Coxeter labelling survives any of the 19 exact labelled-A4 placement branches.

coverage.aggregation_rule: A checkpoint closes only its labelled-A4 placement orbit. The fixed source closes iff the exact 19-orbit partition has size sum 108 and every branch is terminal INFEASIBLE with no survivor.

nonclaims: A terminal branch checkpoint is not by itself a fixed-source theorem.
This certificate does not close the other Record-0 a=1 source orbits.
This certificate does not close the whole Record-0 graph shadow.
No finite-volume noncompact chamber, ideal vertex, affine cusp, or maximal parabolic endpoint is checked.
proof_scope: One fixed compact Record-0 a=1 source orbit, jointly choosing incidence and finite Coxeter labels. Terminal solver statuses are audited artifacts; the expensive branch searches are not rerun.
